info.name: Green-Flame Blade
info.description: Green-Flame Blade (Sword Coast Adventurer's Guide / Xanathar's Guide) — added locally, not part of the core 2024 pack.
info.author: Falling-Cats

element.name: Green-Flame Blade
element.supports: Artificer, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard, Damaging Spell, Melee, Spell Attack

description.p: You brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you. On a hit, the target suffers the attack's normal effects, and green fire leaps from the target to a different creature of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of it. The second creature takes Fire damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.

Cantrip Upgrade. At 5th level, the melee attack deals an extra 1d8 Fire damage to the target on a hit, and the fire damage to the second creature increases to 1d8 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. Both damage rolls increase by 1d8 at 11th level and again at 17th level.

setters.set: a weapon worth 1+ SP with which you are proficient
